topic: Queen Lili's wiped record and surviving letter, a side point of the Void Century silence story
title: Nefertari Lili Vanished From Every Record But One
description: Nefertari Lili, queen of Arabasta, was wiped from the records after the Void Century. One letter survives, and Imu still blames her in chapter 1085.
comment: Is Imu angry at Lili because of what she did, or because of what she knew?

lines.text: Nefertari Lili vanished from every record, and one scrap of paper proves she existed.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: She was the queen of Arabasta eight hundred years ago, one of twenty royals who beat the Great Kingdom.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: Lili chose to go home instead, and that choice is where it gets strange.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: She never arrived. Her records were wiped out and her younger brother took her throne.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: The only proof left is a letter she left behind. Chapter 1084 brings it up.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: Cobra asks the Five Elders about her, and they say she did make it home, but the records are gone.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: Which is the tell. If she went home, someone erased her.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: Then Imu steps out in chapter 1085 and blames her for scattering the Poneglyphs across the world.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: Here's my read: the stones the Government bans are what's left of her mistake.

shot.fallback: anime style ancient stone tablet in a dark ruined library, moody light

lines.text: A whole queen gone from the page. So what was on that page worth the trouble?
